text:
Jordan T: FYI customer report — structured JSON mode over SSE is getting cut off mid-object, parser error on client. Ticket 4572. They see final brace missing repeatedly when streaming through our nginx LB.
Jordan T: Repro steps they gave:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' 'https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/streams?mode=json' --http1.1 -N
# response ends with: ...\ndata: {"choices":[{"delta":{"text":"}\n"}}\n\n```
Jordan T: They pasted the raw response; notice the last chunk ends abruptly with an extra backslash and then no closing brace — JSON.parse fails in their client.
Alex R: can you grab the request_id and route? Also which model variant and region?
Jordan T: request_id=rb-9a2f3c, route=/v1/streams, model=redwood-tuned-v2, region=us-west-2. Customer says it repros with curl and in their app; happens ~10% of streams.
Maya S: any proxy hops between customer and our edge? nginx LB + cloudfront + customer ISP. They said disabling CF made no difference.
Ryan O: quick guess: chunked-transfer framing or an intermediate closing the connection before the final chunk arrives. Could be nginx proxy_buffering/proxy_read_timeout.
Alex R: @Ryan O good call. Jordan can you share nginx config or at least proxy_read_timeout, proxy_buffering status, and proxy_http_version?
Jordan T: customer sent partial nginx conf: proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_buffering on; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 60s; keepalive_timeout 15s.
Maya S: proxy_buffering on could buffer chunked SSE and then flush oddly. Try setting proxy_buffering off and client_max_body_size & proxy_request_buffering off — but they already have request_buffering off.
Ryan O: Also ask them to try curl with `--no-buffer` and `--http1.1 -N` (they already used -N). Repro with `nc` to inspect raw TCP might show missing final chunk or a FIN.
Jordan T: I asked for packet capture; customer returned tcpdump snippet:
```text
12:34:01.123456 IP client->lb: GET /v1/streams ...
12:34:01.456789 IP lb->upstream: FIN, ack seq=...
12:34:01.457000 IP lb->client: FIN, ack
# no further data after FIN
```
Jordan T: looks like LB initiates FIN right after upstream sends what we think is last data — suspicious timing.
Alex R: Could be our runtime not writing final chunk terminator when KV cache flush aligns with a scheduler boundary. Low-level bug in chunk framing. Need eng-runtime to look if we ever omit final CRLF or terminating zero-length chunk in chunked encoding for SSE JSON mode.
Maya S: Also check connection: keepalive vs close header. If upstream sends `Connection: close` we will close and client may get truncated read when socket closes mid-parcel.
SupportBot: Automated note: Related KBs: #streaming-json-truncation, #nginx-chunked-sse. Suggested next step: collect full proxy logs + upstream write traces.
Ryan O: Jordan capture server-side access logs and proxy request/response headers for rb-9a2f3c and share. Also include our runtime debug log around the same timestamp (enable streaming chunk debug level for that request id).
Jordan T: shared logs in ticket — I've uploaded access.log, nginx error.log, and a runtime debug dump. Customer willing to open a maintenance window to test patches.
Alex R: Plan: 1) Eng-runtime to grep for rb-9a2f3c and inspect send buffers. 2) Ask customer to toggle proxy_buffering off and increase proxy_read_timeout to 120s and retest. 3) If repro persists, get pcap + exact bytes to confirm missing chunk terminator. I'll open an eng-runtime incident and tag owners.
Maya S: Quick mitigation suggestion for customer: set a client-side reconnect+stream-merge so partial JSON is retried/continued (temporary). Also advise robust JSON streaming parsing (tolerate incomplete object boundary and attempt reassembly).
Jordan T: I'll run the customer through the config changes and schedule an eng runtime follow-up. Thanks.
Alex R: assigning to eng-runtime (owner: @Ryan O) — please investigate framing/flush logic; flagged as P1 for potential data-loss in structured output streaming. :exclamation:
Ryan O: got it. I'll triage and post findings here. If I need a repro from prod we'll coordinate with SRE for a short window.
Jordan T: closing loop with customer for now, will update thread after they test config changes. :thumbsup:
